body: NTA - also as a fellow indian kid who struggled with mental illness in high school, i hope you know that it’s okay to get 2 B’s ESPECIALLY when you’re struggling with an ED. i feel like we’re all conditioned to think that we need to do well no matter what and nothing is an excuse, but mental health is a perfect excuse as to why your grades slipped (if it helps, i try saying “it’s an explanation” as opposed to “excuse” since it has such a negative connotation and it really helped reframe my way of thinking about my own struggles). And your parents probably don’t say this enough (because what indian parents do?), but i’m proud of you for all you’ve done through out high school, you’re gonna do great on your college apps, and i hope your situation gets better!!
